title: Yanında kalan

characters.MAN: a young man with short black hair, wearing a mustard yellow scarf and an olive green jacket
characters.WOMAN: a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a red knitted beanie and a brown wool coat

scenes.text: Hayat, kimin gerçekten yanında olduğunu bazen en zor gününde gösterir.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy evening, {MAN} sits alone on a wooden park bench with his head down, looking sad. Heavy rain falls, puddles, glowing street lamps.
A rainy cobblestone street at dusk. Many people holding umbrellas walk away from the viewer into the distance. In the foreground an empty wooden bench, wet from the rain.
On a rainy street, {WOMAN} walks toward the viewer holding a large open umbrella above her head, kind caring expression, raindrops, warm street lamps.

scenes.text: Hiçbir şey söylemeden, sadece yanına oturur.
scenes.prompt: Under the rain, two people sit side by side on a wooden park bench sharing one open umbrella: on the left {MAN}, on the right {WOMAN}. Her head rests on his shoulder.
After the rain at sunset, two people walk side by side up a grassy hill, seen from behind: {MAN} and {WOMAN}. Clouds clearing, golden light, autumn trees.

caption:
Zor günler, kimin gerçekten yanımızda olduğunu gösterir. Senin yanında kalan kim? 🤍

Bunu ona gönder, bilsin.
